name: Litmos
summary: Litmos is an LMS aimed at compliance training, with pricing that starts at $8,000 a year for Foundation and $15,000 a year for Platinum. It assigns courses by role, location or risk class, re-enrolls staff before certifications expire and exports audit reports.

facts.text: The pricing page shows Foundation as starting at $8K per year and Platinum as starting at $15K per year; Platinum AI is listed as talk to sales.
The compliance page says courses are assigned automatically by role, location, department or risk classification.
The compliance page describes time-stamped training history for every employee and exportable audit reports in multiple formats.
The compliance page cites more than 17,700 courses across its content libraries, available in 37 or more languages.
